question: How do total sales compare across years?
gold_sql: SELECT c.year, SUM(s.sales) AS total_sales FROM sales AS s JOIN calendar AS c ON s.d = c.d GROUP BY c.year ORDER BY c.year
pred_sql:
WITH yearly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.year,
        SUM(s.sales) AS total_sales
    FROM sales AS s
    JOIN calendar AS c ON s.d = c.d
    GROUP BY c.year
)
SELECT
    year,
    total_sales,
    LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_sales,
    total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS yoy_change,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY year))
        / LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY year),
        2
    ) AS yoy_pct_change
FROM yearly_sales
ORDER BY year
